_doc: Per-loop scoped env for run_all.py. Each loop's closure check runs in its own subprocess with these env vars so a fresh agent can replay the GREEN verdict from the real-data artifacts driven on 2026-06-16. Loop 1 reads the production snapshot at LC_RUNTIME_DB by default and is RED there; to see Loop 1 GREEN on the real free-provider dispatch, point LC_RUNTIME_DB at /tmp/lc_loop1_scoped.db (overridden per-loop below). Re-create any missing artifact by running the matching drive_loop_N.py with DHARMA_SPINE_DISPATCH=1 and these same env vars.
